description: Link a PM schedule to a compliance item, so completing the schedule keeps the item compliant. Requires compliance:write scope. Required: compliance_item_id, pm_schedule_id, required_frequency_days. Resolve both ids first with list_compliance_items and list_pm_schedules.

required_frequency_days.description: How often, in days, the schedule must be completed for the item to stay compliant (required), e.g. 365 for annual

weight.description: Relative weight of this schedule in the item score. Default 1.

name: create_compliance_pm_schedule
title: Create compliance PM schedule
